fields.label: Company
fields.description: Resolved server-side via get_company_context() — never accepted from the client, same invariant as every other Company field in this app.

fields.label: User
fields.description: Always frappe.session.user at creation time — a session belongs to exactly one human identity, never chosen or impersonated via the API.

fields.label: Agent Profile
fields.description: Resolved server-side by AgentRouter from the page context (e.g. cortex-availability, cortex-intake) — never a client-supplied choice. See services/agent_router.py.

fields.label: Onyx Chat Session ID
fields.description: The upstream Onyx session id, once a real Onyx backend is connected. Empty/mocked while OnyxChatClient is MockOnyxChatClient (see HANDOFF.md).

fields.label: Pinned Context Snapshot
fields.description: Set by chat.pin_context, cleared by chat.clear_context. When set, this snapshot's context is used instead of whatever the client's next message sends.

fields.label: Last Context Hash
fields.description: sha256 of the last resolved context — lets the frontend detect a stale/changed context without re-sending the full payload.

fields.label: Retention Until
fields.description: Not populated by any job in this pass — no retention/deletion policy is implemented yet. A real value here today would be a fabricated guarantee; left null until that job exists (tracked in HANDOFF.md).
